record.question: A 3-year-old, 15 kg child with 20% TBSA burns is given Ringer's lactate. How much should be infused in the first 8 hours (using Parkland formula)?
record.explanation: Answer A: 600 mL. Classic Parkland total = 4 mL × 15 kg × 20 = 1,200 mL in 24 hours. Half is infused in the first 8 hours from burn time: 600 mL. Source/context note: This is the classic Parkland calculation; pediatric maintenance fluids and current burn protocols may add requirements. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK482198/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
